Measured glass transition temperatures (Tg) of all synthesized polyurea samples; no melting endotherm observed, confirming the amorphous nature of the polymers.

The polyureas exhibit T_i of 192-229°C, T_10 of 285-327°C, T_max of 443-475°C, and char yield at 700°C of 36-49%, with PPDI-derived polyureas showing highest thermal stability and H12MDI-derived polyureas lowest.
All tested polyureas were amorphous, no crystalline structure was detected.
The poly(amide-urea)s show absorption maxima in the range of 303–429 nm, assigned to the Q Q<sup>-</sup> transition resulting from conjugation between aromatic rings and nitrogen atoms.
